stage2_results.local_context:
# It Was Supposed to Be an AI Call—Then a Human Appeared Backstage

Imagine asking AI to book a haircut. Or asking it to call a store and check whether something is in stock. It could even ask a supplier for a price estimate. In this convenient future, the AI on your screen handles everything for you.

Meta’s AI agent, Muse, really does have phone features like these. So it sounds like a simple story: you make a request, and AI takes care of the call. But the picture changed once people looked behind the stage.

stage2_results.local_context:
### The call that was not made by AI

Some calls through Muse were not made by AI at all. Trained human contract workers made them. Muse received the request—that part was AI—but then passed the job to a person. The worker made the call and finished the conversation. It was like an AI-led play with a hidden supporting actor. The system was called “human concierges.”

The hidden role made the simple picture less simple.

stage2_results.local_context:
### Why the hidden role mattered

Meta employees worried that sensitive information needed for the calls might be shared by mistake with contract workers at a call center. The issue was not that humans handled calls. It was that testing began without clearly telling users about it. A service that seemed simple now looked like a mystery story.

No large information leak was confirmed. But users could not know who was really doing the work they had asked AI to do—and their personal information might reach that person. That uncertainty turned convenience into a mystery.

stage2_results.local_context:

It was that testing began without clearly telling users about it. A service that seemed simple now looked like a mystery story.

verdicts.claim: # It Was Supposed to Be an AI Call—Then a Human Appeared Backstage
verdicts.reason: 一部のMuse経由の電話を人間の契約スタッフが担当した事実を、舞台裏の人間という比喩で表している。

verdicts.claim: In this convenient future, the AI on your screen handles everything for you.
verdicts.reason: 「everything」と、Museがあらゆる作業を処理するかのように範囲を広げており、Ledgerは限定的な機能例のみを裏付ける。

verdicts.reason: 「sounds like」と前置きした物語上の導入で、実際にAIだけが電話を完了するという事実を断定していない。

verdicts.claim: But the picture changed once people looked behind the stage.
verdicts.reason: 舞台裏を見たという比喩的なつなぎで、具体的な新事実を追加していない。

verdicts.claim: ### The call that was not made by AI
verdicts.reason: 人間の契約スタッフが担当した一部の電話がAI自身によるものではなかったというLedgerの事実に合う。

verdicts.claim: Muse received the request—that part was AI—but then passed the job to a person.
verdicts.reason: Museが依頼を受けて人間の担当者に引き継いだという説明は、人間が担当した一部の電話についてのLedgerと一致する。

verdicts.claim: It was like an AI-led play with a hidden supporting actor.
verdicts.reason: AI主導の舞台に隠れた役者がいるという比喩で、独立した具体的事実を加えていない。

verdicts.claim: The hidden role made the simple picture less simple.
verdicts.reason: 物語上の評価・つなぎであり、具体的な事実主張ではない。

verdicts.claim: The issue was not that humans handled calls.
verdicts.reason: 人間が電話を担当したこと自体は問題ではなかったという否定的な評価は、Ledgerに明示された内容と照合できない。

verdicts.claim: It was that testing began without clearly telling users about it.
verdicts.reason: 人間コンシェルジュのテストが適切な開示なしに始まったというLedgerの記録を平易に述べている。

verdicts.claim: A service that seemed simple now looked like a mystery story.
verdicts.reason: ミステリーになぞらえた修辞で、具体的な事実を追加していない。

verdicts.claim: No large information leak was confirmed.
verdicts.reason: 大規模な情報漏えいが確認されなかったという否定的・規模に関する事実は、Ledgerに記載されていない。

verdicts.claim: But users could not know who was really doing the work they had asked AI to do—and their personal information might reach that person.

verdicts.claim: That uncertainty turned convenience into a mystery.
verdicts.reason: 利便性が謎に変わったという比喩的なまとめで、具体的な因果関係を事実として追加していない。

verdicts.claim: The company did not stop Muse itself.

verdicts.claim: In the future, Meta will make the feature public only when it is ready and can clearly explain who will make the call.
